note_tweet.text: Many people publish AI-generated articles on Twitter, which is essentially no different from botting. These articles are worthless. If you truly want to gain knowledge in a particular field, you should seek out original content rather than relying on these machine-generated texts. The existence of such accounts squeezes out space for genuine creators—these AI-generated pieces are not original, yet they are easier to obtain than authentic content since all it takes is a few prompts in ChatGPT. I would call this AI-produced junk.
